D1-275.ctx: Ek shehar chahta hai ke rehaishi chatbot se aise sawal poochein: 'Elm Street par kachra kab uthaya jata hai?' Jawab shehar ke shaya shuda collection schedule mein hain.
D1-275.q: Kaunsa tareeqa sab se munasib hai?
opts: Poore collection schedule ki speech synthesis
Schedule par grounded generative AI chat
Kachre ke dabbon ki tasveeron mein object detection
Har sarak dikhane wale naqshe ki image generation
D1-275.exp: Generative AI chat sawal samajh kar jawab likhta hai, aur usay schedule documents se ground karne se har sarak ke liye jawab sahi hota hai. Speech synthesis sirf text parh kar sunata hai, object detection images ka jaiza leta hai, aur image generation tasveerein banata hai.

D1-276.q: Bank ko aisa assistant chahiye jo customer ka balance dekh sake aur customer ki tasdeeq ke baad us ke accounts ke darmiyan raqam transfer kar sake. Kaunsa solution munasib hai?
opts: Bank statements ki optical character recognition
Text to speech jo customer ka balance bol kar sunaye
Banking tools aur tasdeeq wala AI agent
D1-276.exp: Balance dekhna aur raqam bhejna doosre systems mein amal hain, is liye aisa agent chahiye jo banking APIs ko tools ke taur par call kare, aur hassas amal se pehle tasdeeq ka qadam ho. Key phrase extraction, OCR aur text to speech banking systems mein amal nahi kar sakte.

D1-277.q: AI agent ke aam loop ke qadam sahi tarteeb mein rakhein. Har qadam istemal nahi hota.
items: Tool call karein aur us ka nateeja parhein
Model deployment delete karein
User ka maqsad hasil karein
Nateeje se jawab dein ya agla qadam tay karein
Faisla karein ke kaunsa tool istemal karna hai
D1-277.exp: Agent user ke maqsad se shuru karta hai, sochta hai ke kaunsa tool madad karega, tool call kar ke us ka output parhta hai, aur phir ya to jawab deta hai ya agle qadam ke saath loop dohrata hai. Model deployment delete karne se agent kaam karna band kar dega, is liye woh loop ka hissa nahi.

D1-278.q: Neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: AI agent aisa generative model hai jis ke paas tools nahi hote.
Optical character recognition computer vision ki technique hai.
Podcast ko likhna audio se maloomat nikalta hai.
D1-278.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: agents generative model ko instructions aur tools ke saath jorte hain taake woh amal kar sakein. Doosre ka Haan: OCR tasveeron se text parhta hai. Teesre ka Nahi: sentiment analysis text par kaam karta hai, is liye woh text analysis workload hai. Chauthe ka Haan: transcript bole hue content ko aisa text banata hai jise talash aur analyze kiya ja sake.

D1-279.q: Har scenario ko us AI workload se milayein jise woh zahir karta hai. Har workload ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Shaya karne se pehle street photos mein chehray khud dhundlana
Video ki English speech se Spanish subtitles banana
Sales calls ke baad har customer ke liye follow-up emails ka draft banana
Scan kiye hue bank statements se account number nikalna
D1-279.exp: Dhundlane ke liye chehray dhoondna computer vision hai. English speech ko Spanish subtitles banana speech translation hai. Nayi, har customer ke mutabiq emails likhna generative AI hai. Statements se account numbers parhna information extraction hai. Text analysis, jaise sentiment ya key phrases, kisi scenario ka asal kaam nahi.

D1-280.q: Kaunse DO kaam kai qadam aur amal maangte hain aur AI agent ke liye munasib hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Ek jumla translate karna
Suppliers ki qeematein mila kar buyer ko khulasa email karna
Ek review ka sentiment positive, neutral ya negative batana
Tickets ki qataar dekhna aur teams ko dena
Ek photo ka caption likhna
D1-280.exp: Suppliers ki tehqeeq kar ke khulasa email karna, ya tickets baant kar update karna, mansooba-bandi, kai tool calls aur doosre systems mein amal maangta hai, aur agents isi ke liye hain. Jumla translate karna, ek review classify karna aur ek photo ka caption likhna ek ek model call ke kaam hain.

D1-281.q: Har khali jagah ke liye sahi option chun kar jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-281.tpl: Receipt ki photo se text parhna {0} hai. Us receipt ke baare mein chat mein sawalon ke jawab dena {1} hai.
D1-281.exp: OCR receipts jaisi tasveeron se chhapa hua text parhta hai. Jo chat sawal samajh kar content ke baare mein jawab likhe woh generative AI hai. Speech synthesis aur recognition audio par kaam karte hain, sentiment analysis raye parakhta hai, aur object detection sawalon ke jawab dene ke bajaye cheezein dhoondta hai.

D1-282.q: Named entity recognition kya karta hai?
opts: Text ko user ki chuni hui doosri zaban mein translate karta hai
Text se audio banata hai
Text mein log, jagahein, tareekhein waghera pehchanta hai
Images mein cheezon ke gird boxes bana kar har ek ka naam batata hai
D1-282.exp: Named entity recognition text mein entities pehchan kar unhein Person, Location, Organization aur DateTime jaise categories deta hai. Translation, speech synthesis aur object detection alag capabilities hain.

D1-283.ctx: Ek hotel chain ke paas 12 zabanon mein 10,000 reviews hain aur woh har zaban ki sab se aam shikayaton ka dashboard chahti hai.
D1-283.q: Text analysis techniques ka kaunsa jor munasib hai?
opts: Language detection, phir opinion mining
Reviews ka OCR, phir object detection
Speech synthesis, phir reviews ka tarjuma
Har shikayat ke liye chart ki image generation
D1-283.exp: Language detection reviews ko zaban ke hisaab se group karta hai, aur opinion mining ya key phrase extraction batata hai ke mehmaan kis baat ki shikayat karte hain. OCR aur object detection images par kaam karte hain, speech synthesis audio banata hai, aur image generation tasveerein banata hai, is liye koi bhi review text ka jaiza nahi leta.

D1-284.q: Text analysis ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Key phrase extraction sirf PDF files mein mehfooz text par kaam karta hai.
Sentiment analysis social media posts par istemal ho sakta hai.
Summarization lambe article ko chhota karta hai.
D1-284.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: text analysis kisi bhi jagah ke saada text par kaam karta hai, jaise emails, chats ya posts. Doosre ka Haan: sentiment analysis aksar social media par raye par nazar rakhne ke liye istemal hota hai. Teesre ka Haan: summarization lambe text ka chhota version banata hai.

D1-285.q: Har karobari sawal ko us text analysis technique se milayein jo us ka jawab deti hai. Har technique ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Customers kaunse mauzu ka sab se zyada zikr karte hain?
Yeh message English mein likha hai ya French mein?
Is report mein kaunse jumlay sab se ahem hain?
Kya is note mein credit card number hai?
D1-285.exp: Mauzu key phrase extraction se aate hain, zaban language detection se, sab se ahem jumlay extractive summarization se, aur credit card numbers PII detection se. Entity linking naamon ko knowledge base ki entries se jorta hai aur in mein se kisi sawal ka jawab nahi deta.

D1-286.q: Ek company support emails ko apni categories, jaise Refund, Shipping aur Warranty, mein baantna chahti hai aur us ke paas saikron label ki hui misaalein hain. Kaunsa feature munasib hai?
D1-286.exp: Custom text classification label ki hui misaalon se aap ki apni categories seekhta hai aur phir unhein nayi emails par lagata hai. Language detection sirf zaban batata hai, speech translation audio par kaam karta hai, aur image tags tasveeron ko bayan karte hain.

D1-287.q: Jumla yeh hai: 'We sailed down the Amazon for a week.' Jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-287.tpl: Entity linking 'Amazon' ko {0} ke article se jorega. Named entity recognition 'Amazon' par {1} ka label lagayega.
D1-287.exp: 'sailed down' ka context dikhata hai ke Amazon se murad darya hai, is liye entity linking usay darya ki knowledge base entry se jorta hai, aur named entity recognition us par Location ka label lagata hai. Usay company se jorna context ko nazar andaz karna hota, aur entity linking bilkul yahi ibhaam door karta hai.

D1-288.q: Ek phone system har voicemail ka text recipient ko email karta hai. Woh kaunsa Speech feature istemal karta hai?
D1-288.exp: Speech to text record ki hui voicemail ko text banata hai jise email kiya ja sake. Text to speech aur custom voice (jise pehle custom neural voice kehte the) audio banate hain, aur keyword recognition sirf khaas wake word pakarta hai.

D1-289.q: Game ke ek character ko kuch lines mein pur-josh aur kuch mein udaas lagna chahiye. Azure Speech se yeh kaise karenge?
opts: Speech to text istemal kar ke transcript haath se badalna
Har line kaisi lagti hai, is ka score lene ke liye pronunciation assessment
Neural voice ke liye SSML mein speaking style set karna
Jazbati alfaaz pehchanne ke liye keyword recognition istemal karna
D1-289.exp: Kuch neural voices speaking styles, jaise cheerful ya sad, support karti hain, jinhein har line ke liye SSML se chuna jata hai. Speech to text, pronunciation assessment aur keyword recognition aane wali speech ka jaiza lete hain aur synthesized speech ki awaaz nahi badal sakte.

D1-290.q: Azure Speech ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Speech translation ke liye bolne wale ko pehle apne alfaz type karne parte hain.
Text-to-speech ka output audio file ki soorat mein save ho sakta hai.
Real-time speech to text tab text deta hai jab bolne wala poori recording khatam kar le.
D1-290.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: speech translation seedha boli hui audio par kaam karta hai. Doosre ka Haan: synthesized audio chalayi ja sakti hai ya WAV jaisi file mein likhi ja sakti hai. Teesre ka Nahi: darmiyani recognizing nateejon se apps bolne ke dauran hi text dikha sakti hain.

D1-291.q: Har scenario ko us Speech feature se milayein jo woh istemal karta hai. Har feature ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Bol kar document mein notes likhwana
News article buland awaaz mein parhna
Doosri zaban bolne wale se baat karna
Nayi zaban bolne ki mashq karna aur score lena
D1-291.exp: Bol kar likhwana speech to text hai, parh kar sunana text to speech, do zabanon ki guftagu speech translation, aur seekhne wale ke bolne ko score dena pronunciation assessment hai. Image captioning tasveeron ko bayan karta hai aur Speech feature nahi.

D1-292.q: Speech to text kaunsi TEEN cheezein de sakta hai? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Synthesized voice jo text parhe
Bole hue alfaz ka transcript
Bolne wale shakhs ki bani hui image
Pehchane hue alfaz ka timing
Transcript mein punctuation aur capitalization
D1-292.exp: Speech to text transcript deta hai, alfaaz ka waqt bata sakta hai aur display text mein punctuation aur capitalization lagata hai. Synthesized voice text to speech se aati hai, aur images image-generation model se.

D1-293.q: Aap ko khaas alfaz wali industry ke liye custom speech model chahiye. Qadam sahi tarteeb mein rakhein. Har qadam istemal nahi hota.
items: Custom endpoint deploy karein aur apni app mein istemal karein
Neural voice chunein
Apne domain ka audio aur text data jama karein
Custom model test karein aur usay base model se compare karein
Data upload karein aur custom model train karein
D1-293.exp: Custom speech domain ke data se shuru hota hai, jo upload ho kar training mein istemal hota hai. Phir custom model ko base model ke muqable mein test kiya jata hai taake behtari ki tasdeeq ho, aur us ke baad endpoint par deploy kiya jata hai jise app call karti hai. Neural voice chunna text-to-speech ka kaam hai, recognition ki training ka hissa nahi.

D1-294.exp: OCR ka matlab optical character recognition hai: aisi technology jo tasveeron aur scan kiye hue documents mein chhape hue ya haath ke likhe huroof pehchan kar parhti hai. Baqi tafseelat ghari hui hain aur kisi computer vision technique ko bayan nahi kartin.

D1-295.q: Medical imaging mein semantic segmentation kis kaam ke liye istemal hota hai?
opts: Kisi uzv ka theek hissa nishan karna
Scan par mareez ka naam parhna
Naya scan banana
Mareez ke liye radiology report ka tarjuma karna
D1-295.exp: Semantic segmentation har pixel ko ek class deta hai, is liye woh kisi uzv ya doosri structure ka bilkul sahi hissa numayan kar sakta hai. Naam parhna OCR hai, scans banana image generation hai, aur reports translate karna zaban ka kaam hai.

D1-296.q: Computer vision ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Object detection har image mein cheezon ki ek hi qism dhoondta hai.
OCR sirf English mein likhe text tak mehdood hai.
Image classification bata sakta hai ke image mein kitni gaariyan hain aur kahan hain.
D1-296.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: detection har mili hui cheez ka box aur label deta hai, aur cheezein mukhtalif qismon ki ho sakti hain. Doosre ka Nahi: OCR bohat si zabanein aur scripts support karta hai. Teesre ka Nahi: classification poori tasveer ke labels deta hai; cheezein ginna aur un ki jagah batana object detection hai.

D1-297.q: Marketing team image-generation model istemal karna shuru karti hai. Unhein kaunse DO khatron ko sambhalna chahiye? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Model hamesha bilkul ek jaisi tasveerein banata hai
Images mein logon ke stereotypes ho sakte hain
Model prompts par chal nahi sakta
Images mein ghaltiyan, jaise ghalat spelling, ho sakti hain
Bani hui tasveerein trademarks ke liye khud clear ho jati hain
D1-297.exp: Image models apne training data ke stereotypes dohra sakte hain aur bigre hue text jaisi ghaltiyan kar sakte hain, is liye outputs ka review zaroori hai. Woh hamesha ek jaisi tasveerein nahi banate, prompts par chalte hain, aur generation se trademarks khud clear nahi hote.

D1-298.q: Har khali jagah ke liye sahi option chun kar jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-298.tpl: Photo mein har dog kahan hai yeh dhoondna {0} hai. Yeh tay karna ke photo mein dog hai bhi ya nahi {1} hai.
D1-298.exp: Object detection har cheez ko dhoond kar us ki jagah bounding box se batata hai. Image classification batata hai ke poori tasveer kya dikhati hai. OCR text parhta hai aur in mein se koi kaam nahi karta.

D1-299.q: Ek online store chahta hai ke product photos se color aur category jaisi khususiyat khud bhar jayein. Kaunsi technique munasib hai?
opts: Products ke naamon ki speech synthesis
Product descriptions par language detection
Images se information extraction
Product videos ki batch transcription
D1-299.exp: Tasveeron se khususiyat ko naam wale fields mein nikalna, maslan Content Understanding ke image analyzer se, photos ko structured catalog data banata hai. Speech synthesis, language detection aur batch transcription audio ya text par kaam karte hain, images par nahi.

D1-300.q: Har extraction technique ko us source se milayein jis ke liye woh asal mein istemal hoti hai. Har source ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
targets: Tables wale scan kiye hue documents
D1-300.exp: Layout analysis documents mein tables jaisi structure dhoondta hai, diarization audio mein speakers alag karta hai, keyframe extraction video se numainda frames chunta hai, aur OCR tasveeron aur documents ka text parhta hai. Embedding vectors embedding models ka output hain, in techniques ka source nahi.

D1-301.q: Information extraction solution ka aam output kya hota hai?
opts: Structured data, jaise JSON fields
Nayi image jo nikali hui values dikhaye
Background music
Model deployment jise doosri apps call kar sakein
D1-301.exp: Information extraction be-tarteeb content ko structured data banata hai, jaise JSON mein invoice number aur total, jise doosre systems istemal kar sakein. Woh tasveerein, music ya deployments nahi banata.

D1-302.q: Sales call ki recording se maloomat nikalne ke qadam sahi tarteeb mein rakhein. Har qadam istemal nahi hota.
items: Transcript se summary aur topic fields banayein
Caller ki tasveer banayein
Fields ko CRM system mein save karein
Call ki recording upload karein
Speech ko likhein (transcribe)
D1-302.exp: Recording upload hoti hai, speech likhi jati hai, transcript se summary aur topics jaise fields bante hain, aur structured nateeja CRM mein save hota hai. Caller ki tasveer banana naya content banata hai aur maloomat nahi nikalta.
